title: Butter Chicken Classic Murgh Makhani

description: Experience the rich and creamy indulgence of classic Butter Chicken, a beloved Indian culinary masterpiece. Tender chicken pieces are simmered in a luscious tomato-based gravy, enriched with butter, cream, and aromatic spices. This Murgh Makhani recipe promises an authentic taste of India, perfect for a comforting and satisfying meal.

ingredients.notes: soaked in hot water for 15 minutes

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: In a bowl, combine chicken pieces with yogurt, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, 1/2 tsp red chili powder, turmeric, 1/2 tsp garam masala, and salt. Mix well and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or preferably 2-4 hours in the refrigerator.

instructions.title: Cook the Chicken
instructions.text: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken in batches and sear until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove chicken and set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Gravy Base
instructions.text: In the same pan, add 2 tbsp butter. Add green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, and bay leaf. Sauté for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5-7 minutes.

instructions.title: Add Aromatics and Spices
instructions.text: Add the remaining 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Stir in 1/2 tsp red chili powder, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.

instructions.title: Simmer the Gravy
instructions.text: Add the tomato puree to the pan. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil separates. While it simmers, blend the soaked cashews with a little water to make a smooth paste.

instructions.title: Finish the Makhani Sauce
instructions.text: Stir in the cashew paste, remaining 1/2 tsp garam masala, crushed kasuri methi, and sugar (if using). Add the cooked chicken back to the pan. Pour in the heavy cream and 1 tbsp butter. Mix gently and simmer for 5-7 minutes until the chicken is heated through and the sauce is rich and creamy.

instructions.title: Serve
instructions.text: Taste and adjust salt if needed. Garnish generously with fresh chopped coriander. Serve hot with naan bread, roti, or basmati rice.

tips: For a deeper flavor, try grilling or baking the marinated chicken in a tandoor or oven until lightly charred before adding it to the gravy.
Always use good quality, ripe tomatoes for the puree, or opt for canned crushed tomatoes for consistent flavor. Avoid overly sour tomatoes.
To achieve a silky smooth gravy, blend the cooked tomato-onion base before adding the chicken and cream. Strain it through a fine-mesh sieve for an even restaurant-like finish.
